details: Designed and delivered cloud-based business solutions across AWS, collaborating on scalable backend services and infrastructure supporting multiple production applications while improving deployment consistency and system reliability.

Led the development and optimization of automated data processing and reporting solutions, consolidating data from 10+ sources and generating reports containing 100,000+ records, reducing manual processing time while improving reporting accuracy and consistency.

Designed and enhanced enterprise data management solutions for financial operations, implementing and maintaining 20+ APIs and database workflows that supported high-volume transaction processing while improving data quality and operational efficiency.

Planned and implemented scalable system architectures across cloud services, databases, and application platforms, contributing to the design of 15+ interconnected components and deployment pipelines that improved scalability, monitoring, and long-term maintainability.

Supported the delivery and stability of production cloud environments by leading root-cause analysis and infrastructure improvements across 30+ production issues and enhancement requests, helping increase platform reliability and reducing recurring operational incidents.

Built and deployed a web app using Quasar (Vue 3), Spring Boot, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Keycloak, containerized with Docker, and deployed on Kubernetes Rancher, enabling scalable architecture for 10+ RESTful microservices.
Designed and implemented CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions, automating code checks and deployments to a private Docker registry, reducing deployment time by 40%, and ensuring consistent delivery.

Developed and maintained 20+ pages of technical documentation, covering system architecture, API endpoints, and authentication workflows, cutting onboarding time for new developers by 50% and improving sprint predictability by 30%.
Design and develop interactive mockups using Figma, enhancing existing wireframes and improving user experience for 3+ major projects
Create and manage a PostgreSQL database model on the cloud to store inputs for a ship routing system, accessed and manipulated via custom Python scripts
Lead QA efforts for a team of 5, ensuring high-quality outputs and reducing errors by 20% through rigorous testing protocols
Manage and execute queries on the Firebase database using BigQuery, processing over 100,000 data entries daily
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance data pipeline efficiency, resulting in a 20% reduction in query processing time
Contribute to data quality assurance by implementing validation checks, leading to a 15% decrease in data error instances
Designed an adaptive testing algorithm that uses machine learning to gauge the test taker’s ability and adjust the test accordingly, boosting engagement by 20% and enhancing completion rates by 15%
Served as full stack Django developer, optimizing website speed by 25%
Transitioned to project manager to lead a team of 3 developers with full documentation on previous and future work, achieving 15% better project delivery efficiency and 10% higher team satisfaction
Constructed game logic, levels, mechanics, GUI, animations, and special effects with Unity, resulting in 2 complete, playable games with optimized performance and minimal bugs
Developed 2 game prototypes using Unity, optimized game performance, and achieved a 99% bug-free rate
